title: Three Practical Steps to Strengthen Financial Performance
summary: Discover three practical steps to strengthen financial performance, improve decision-making, and support long-term financial stability.
body_markdown:
**NRHA’s Rural Health Voices Blog**


# Three Practical Steps to Strengthen Financial Performance


September 30, 2026


**Jigar S. Patel, M.D., FAMIA**


Chief Medical and Innovation Officer


In this article for the National Rural Health Association (NRHA), Jigar Patel, M.D. outlines a practical framework for strengthening financial performance: understand market dynamics, analyze growth opportunities, and act on targeted initiatives that support both community health needs and long-term sustainability.


Explore the three-part model from Dr. Patel that can turn market data into smarter decisions to help protect both financial performance and access to care.


[Read the Full Article](https://www.ruralhealth.us/blogs/2026/06-june/three-practical-steps-to-strengthen-financial-performance)
